dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: Nara Jazari is also a strange Nara, screaming loud like he is ill. But Ararycan doesn't think he is bad.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: He could be Ararycan's friend, only if he sees Ararycan.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Please be good friends with Jazari, Nara {NICKNAME}, Ararycan hopes so.

dialogues.speaker: Ararycan
dialogues.text: #Also, Ararycan hopes Nara {NICKNAME} won't be scared by the screams of Nara Jazari.
